L360@P9: 6.5 Comply with BSMI7. PRECAUTIONS FOR USING LITHIUM ION RECHARGEABLE CELL
L361@P9: The precautions described below are important to assure the performance and safety of
L362@P9: designed pack. Mishandling may cause cell leakage, heat, smoke, explosion or fire. Please
L363@P9-10: follow instructions carefully. Document
L364@P10: Name Cell Specifications of INR-21700-P42A

L368@P10: 7.1 Intended Use
L369@P10: Cordless screw driver, Cordless drill/driver, Cordless impact driver, Cordless tubing
L370@P10: cutter, Cordless angle grinder, Cordless polisher/waxer, Power tool, Electrical vehicle,
L371@P10: PHEV. The cell is prohibited to use in e-cigarette, vaporizers (e-cig, vape, mod) or any
L372@P10: other similar devices applications.
L373@P10: 7.2 Handling Precautions
L374@P10: 7.2.1 Charging
L375@P10: The lithium ion rechargeable cell is to be charged by “constant current/constant
L376@P10: voltage” method. The lithium ion cell is charged at a constant current (CC Mode)
L377@P10: until the cell voltage reaches a specific voltage, followed by a constant voltage
L378@P10: charge (CV Mode) at the specific voltage. The charging current at this constant
L379@P10: voltage tapers off. As long as the tapering current is down to a particular current,
L380@P10: the charge process is deemed complete.
L381@P10: 1) Charge voltage:
L382@P10: Do not exceed the specified charge voltage (4.2V per single cell). If the cells
L383@P10: are used in battery packs, the maximum voltage is 4.2 x N (N= number of
L384@P10: cells connected in series) V.
L385@P10: 2) Charge current:
L386@P10: Charge the cell at the specified charge current listed in section 4.10 or less.
L387@P10: 3) Charge temperature:
L388@P10: Charge the cell at the temperature range of 0°C ~ 45°C. Due consideration
L389@P10: should also be given to the arrangement of the battery pack so that it is in
L390@P10: that temperature range even though it is effected by heat generated from
L391@P10: the cell charger.
L392@P10: 7.2.2 Reverse charging:
L393@P10: The cell must be prevented from reverse-polarity charging.
L394@P10: 7.2.3 Discharging
L395@P10: A lithium ion rechargeable cell starts to discharge at 4.2V and terminates at a
L396@P10: cut off voltage of 2.5V.
L397@P10: 1) Discharge current:
L398@P10: Discharge the cell at the specified discharge current listed in section 4.10 or
L399@P10: less. In case a peak current of higher than maximum discharge current
L400@P10-11: depending on the pulse interval may reduce the cell capacity.Document
L401@P11: Name Cell Specifications of INR-21700-P42A
L402@P11: Document No. INR21700P42A-03 Ver. 1.0 Page 11 of 14
L403@P11: -- CONFIDENTIAL --
L404@P11: Proprietary of E-One Moli Energy Corp.
L405@P11: 2) Discharge temperature:
L406@P11: Discharge the cell at temperature range from –40°C to 60°C. At a
L407@P11: temperature of –40°C or less, the cell will show a significant decrease in
L408@P11: discharge capacity. The cell surface temperature must not exceed 85°C.
L409@P11: Recommended thermal cut-off of 75°C at high rates.
L410@P11: 3) Discharge termination voltage/Over discharge:
L411@P11: Avoid discharge to voltage less than 2.5V per single cell. A leakage current
L412@P11: to the equipment may over discharge the cell, which may damage the
L413@P11: performance of cell.
L414@P11: 7.2.4 Long-term Storage
L415@P11: 1) In case of long-term storage, store the cell at <23 °C, low humidity,
L416@P11: noncorrosive gas atmosphere.
L417@P11: 2) The cell voltage should be maintained at greater than 2.5V. Should the cell
L418@P11: voltage approach to 2.5V (0%SOC) it is recommended that the cell be
L419@P11: charged back up to 30% capacity.
L420@P11: 3) Do not store cell in humid environment.
L421@P11-12: 4) Long-term Storage may cause loss of capacity recovery.Document

L426@P12: 7.3 Safety Precautions
L427@P12: 7.3.1 When using the cell
L428@P12: WARNING
L429@P12: 1) Mishandling of a cell can lead to generation of heat, possible explosion or
L430@P12: ignition and potential serious injury. Safe handling guidelines include the
L431@P12: following:
L432@P12: (1) Do not expose cell to fire or heat.
L433@P12: (2) Do not install the cell backwards.
L434@P12: (3) Do not expose the cell to water or salt water, or allow the cell to get
L435@P12: wet.
L436@P12: (4) Do not carry or store the cells together with necklaces, hairpins or
L437@P12: other metal objects.
L438@P12: (5) Do not place the cells in microwave ovens, high-pressure containers,
L439@P12: or on induction cookware.
L440@P12: (6) Do not connect the positive terminal and the negative terminal of the
L441@P12: cell to each other with any metal objects such as chains, coins or wire.
L442@P12: (7) Do not pierce the cell with nails, strike the cell with a hammer, step on
L443@P12: the cell, or otherwise subject it to strong impacts or shocks.
L444@P12: 2) Do not disassemble or modify the cell. The cell contains safety and
L445@P12: protection devices, that if damaged, may cause the cell to generate heat,
L446@P12: explode or ignite.
L447@P12: 3) Do not place the cell in or near fire, stoves, or other high-temperature
L448@P12: locations. Do not place the cell in direct sunshine or use or store the cell
L449@P12: inside cars in hot weather. Doing so may cause the cell to generate heat,
L450@P12: explode, or ignite. Using the cell in this manner may also result in a loss of
L451@P12: performance and a shortened life expectancy.
L452@P12: 4) Do not use the cell in e-cigarette, vaporizers (e-cig, vape, mod) or any other
L453@P12: similar devices applications.
L454@P12: 5) Venting device description
L455@P12: Safety Valve: Allowing controlled release of pressure in the event of
L456@P12-13: excessive internal gas build up.Document
